purpose: Teach: 糞/ガール/うーむ/じゃぁ/仔/菊/帖/フン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「糞、また書類が増えた」って疲れて仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was complaining — he said 'Dammit, more paperwork' — he sounded so tired.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone sharing an adult frustration. Light amusement at his exhaustion. Gentle cadence, almost affectionate about his complaint.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「お友達の女の子、つまりガールフレンドはまだ?」って聞かれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad asked me if I had a girlfriend yet — he was like 'So, do you have a girl who's your friend?'
lines.style: Quiet surprise mixed with shy amusement. Matter-of-fact in reporting the question, but a small hesitation on the word 'girlfriend.' Natural, conversational delivery without exaggeration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「うーむ、難しいな」って唸ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father just kind of hummed and said 'Hmm, that's a tricky one.'
lines.style: Soft, knowing amusement underneath. She's watching his reaction form. Slow delivery, like she's noticing his pause is revealing something. Tender observation, not mockery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「じゃぁ、宿題終わったらね」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, then Dad told me 'Well, finish your homework first, then we'll talk.'
lines.style: Earnest, straightforward reporting. A hint of acceptance in his voice — like it's a fair condition. Simple, clear delivery without irony. Child taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「仔猫を保護したい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned he wants to rescue a kitten.
lines.style: Soft, tender observation. Pause before 'kitten' — like she's noticing something gentle in his nature. Quiet approval underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery masking real affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと菊の花を植えたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I planted chrysanthemums together today.
lines.style: Pleased, genuine contentment in the memory. Bright but not loud. Pride in the shared moment — 'together' carries weight. Simple, direct, happy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「八帖の客間に布団を敷くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd lay out futon in the eight-tatami guest room.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight pause after 'eight-tatami' — specific detail she's relaying. Calm, domestic tone. No emotion, just information.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「フン、まだまだだぞ」って試されたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad tested me — he said 'Hmph, you've still got a long way to go.'
lines.style: Wry, dry delivery. Small smile underneath. He's challenging him in that gruff-affectionate way. Report it with a hint of 'that's so like him.' Light, knowing tone.
